## Type of change

- [ ] `type:bug`: fixes a defect without changing documented behavior
- [ ] `type:feature`: adds a capability without breaking existing behavior
- [ ] `type:docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `type:refactor`: no behavior change
- [ ] `type:chore`: build, CI, dependencies or tooling
- [ ] `type:breaking-change`: changes existing behavior others rely on
